title: Halted configurations remain fixed
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes, let $b$ be a choice bit, and let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input whose state component is empty. Then one step under choice $b$ leaves $c$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes
A configuration $c$ on a fixed input
The state component of $c$ is empty
replaced:
Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine, $b \in \{0,1\}$ a choice bit, and
$c$ a configuration of $M$ on some input whose state component is empty (the machine has
halted).  Then one step of $M$ from $c$ under $b$ leaves $c$ unchanged.
